mostWorthwhile.text: Building the supplied living bone was worthwhile: the planned cutaway distinguishes vessels from the tiny channels that carry nutrients toward embedded bone cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to add bone cells directly to the mineralised framework was frustrating because the required order was not apparent.

surprise.text: I did not expect the bone cells to need a blood-supply combination before joining the framework. The resulting picture clarified how nutrients reach osteocytes.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the blood supply to be linked to the cells before they could join the framework felt like an unexplained ordering constraint, even though the supply itself had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connect tissue structure to function, especially in the supplied bone and fluid-lined joint, though I would hope future ordering constraints are clearer.
